author: Slaide
description: AI presentation maker: build, edit and export PowerPoint slide decks, Word documents and Excel workbooks from chat.
name: Presentations & Slides by Slaide

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: List your Slaide documents by title or recency.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read the pages, speaker notes or cells of one of your Slaide documents.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Start a background job that builds a new presentation, document or workbook from a topic, notes or an attached file.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Change pages of an existing Slaide document. Changes are versioned and can be restored in Slaide.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Report the progress and the result of a Slaide job.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Export a document as PowerPoint, PDF, Word, PNG or Excel behind a private link that expires after 15 minutes.
